blurb: Guests join 6-day sailing charters in the San Juan Islands, either reserving a private stateroom on a shared cruise or booking a private charter for their own group of up to six. Trips begin Sunday and end Friday, with all cabins double occupancy and a non-smoking yacht. The yacht departs from Bellingham, Washington, and includes meals, beverages, towels, linens, and use of an ocean kayak.
